title: Athoos
tagline: Athoos introduces a trustless, permissionless trust-scoring system for crypto wallets without KYC, featuring wallet scoring, trust-based pool creation, and score-conditional swapping.

prizes.title: Best UX/UI implementation of Nouns Art

description: Athoos leverages the power of blockchain to create a novel trust-scoring system, enabling a new layer of transparency and security in crypto transactions. This system allows users to view trust scores for any wallet, create pools with trust score-based whitelisting, and swap within pools meeting minimum trust scores. By eliminating the need for KYC, Athoos pushes us for a more inclusive, decentralized and privacy-preserving Web3 space.
how_its_made: Our stack combines Next.js for the front end with Dynamics SDK for seamless Web2 to Web3 integration, facilitating user-friendly wallet creation via email sign-ins and passkeys. We use FlashBot Suave for backend processes, maintaining transparency off-chain and using AI in our trust scoring algorithm. Trust validation in pools and swaps leverages Uniswap v4 hooks, ensuring secure and trust-based transactions. Deployed on Base, Athoos represents a synergy of account abstraction, AI, and DeFi.
